title: Contract or Error Path?
prompt: Implement `const char *classify_condition(int kind)` mapping: 0 (NULL from malloc) → "error-handling", 1 (user typed negative size) → "error-handling", 2 (internal: node->next == node in an acyclic list) → "assert", 3 (file open failure) → "error-handling", 4 (internal: popped an empty stack the API forbids) → "assert". The rule: caller-controllable or environmental → handle; contract-impossible → assert.

tests.name: environmental conditions
tests.hint: Allocation failure and file errors happen in correct programs — they need error paths, not asserts.

tests.name: contract violations
tests.hint: A cycle in an acyclic list or a forbidden pop is an internal bug — assert fires in debug, aborts loudly.
